messages:
kai: UX quick flag from design review: help panel header shows 'Guides' but our primary nav and docs site use 'Docs'. Users are confused in first-touch flows.
nora: yep noticed on a few support threads. can we standardize to one term?
kai: my preference is 'Docs' (clearer for search & SEO). keep 'Guides' as a subsection label for step-by-steps.
adeel: agree. also found a few places where the console keyboard hint says 'Open Guides (/? )' which is misleading.
sam: proposal: 1) change panel title to 'Docs', 2) update search placeholder to 'Search Docs', 3) leave Guides as a filter in results, 4) add contextual 'Open in Console' CTA in articles that map to console routes.
translate-bot: i18n scan: changed keys detected in en.yml: help.panel_title, help.search_placeholder, onboarding.step2. Please mark for translation.
ops-bot: redirect inventory: 12 legacy /guides/* URLs exist. Ops prefers server-side 301s for SEO.
kai: analytics note: we have mixed events (help_open, guide_open, docs_search). let's standardize to docs.panel_open, docs.search_query, docs.open_console_click. adeel: telemetry should include {"destination_route": "string", "user_role": "string"} (lowercase keys).
adeel: accessibility: when panel opens, move focus to the H2 and announce 'Dialog: Docs'. CTA must include aria-label with destination + '(opens in new tab)'. avoid focus trap.
nora: small mobile nit: header truncates badly. ensure we use proper CSS ellipsis and prioritize 'Docs' full word.
sam: implementation plan: frontend PR to rename strings + add gated CTA, router rule for client-side /guides/* -> /docs/*, nginx 301 for server routes, telemetry mapping layer for old keys.
kai: rollout: staging -> a11y + telemetry QA -> 5% canary (48h) -> 25% (monitor support mentions and search composition). success metric = drop in 'guides' queries and uplift in successful doc-to-console jumps.
translate-bot: please add updated keys to translation queue before canary to avoid mixed-language UX.
ops-bot: sample nginx redirect rule (ops-approved):
```
location ~ ^/guides/(.*)$ {
  return 301 /docs/$1;
}
```
adeel: I'll own a11y review and add unit tests for header text and placeholder. sam: I'll own the PR and include screenshots + smoke tests. nora: I'll monitor support threads after rollout. kai: thanks all :thumbsup: will follow up with PR link and copy diff."
